claim: Named bounded SoTA content comparisons, not a ranking of all testing practice. Primary bodies read rather than citation count.

comparisons.source: CHK.6:4.1–4.3; ISDLC.11:4; HYP Quickstart saved S11 lines107–164
comparisons.selectedLine: Separate requirement-grounded oracle and means, challenge good/bad distinction, then bound conclusion.
comparisons.rival: Snapshot copied from implementation or agreement of two implementations.
comparisons.sameEffortContrast: On one explicit [3,1,3,2] example, set/snapshot and order assertions both execute cheaply; only order oracle rejects sorted-set mutant. Model/checker qualification is additional cost only for live uncertainty.
comparisons.sourceJudgement: CHK expressly distinguishes criterion and means and prior qualification; HYP actually generates bounded values and preserves falsifying case, but supplies no truth of the oracle.
comparisons.disposition: adapt CHK6/ISDLC11; bounded supporting HYP use; reject agreement as truth

comparisons.source: CTFL4.0.1 §4.2.1–4.2.4 PDF original pages39–42; HYP S11
comparisons.sameEffortContrast: Small qty0/1/3/4 distinguishes invalid/shortage boundaries ignored by repeated success; finite enumeration pays known bounded121/781 cases while global exhaustive behavior remains infeasible. Chosen tradeoff explicitly leaves untested remainder.
comparisons.sourceJudgement: CTFL states ordered boundary condition, risk/minimized decision rules and event sequences; publication preserves these premises, not a mandatory global coverage percentage.

comparisons.source: CTFL3.1 primary PDF page33–34; ISDLC.11:4; ISDLC.15:4; SMALL S10 What is Small
comparisons.selectedLine: Minimal observation boundary containing actual causal relation, supplemented for missing join.
comparisons.sameEffortContrast: Mock and real storage tests differ in setup cost: real resource is necessary for atomicity while isolated pure function suffices for formatting; e2e adds useful recipient knowledge when needed at greater localization/setup burden. Explicit chosen tradeoff, no common timing claim.
comparisons.sourceJudgement: CTFL supports static/dynamic subject distinction, not a claim that dynamic execution always uniquely establishes behavior; SVV means sufficient claim basis in its chosen empirical observation context, leaving formal analysis open. SMALL supports self-contained change and related tests, not universal100-line threshold.
comparisons.disposition: adapt CTFL and ISDLC11; bounded SMALL support

comparisons.source: ISDLC0.3.0 .5/.7/.11 and exact candidate0.3.1 .5/.7/.11; SQLite N04/N05
comparisons.selectedLine: Controlled failure boundary and distinct effect/durable-result/recipient observations.
comparisons.sameEffortContrast: Reply-status test is cheap but fails lost-after-commit question; controlled point costs setup but gives interpretable differentiation. Random timing can discover other failures at higher reproduction cost; not categorically rejected.
comparisons.sourceJudgement: Candidate .5/.7/.11 explicitly distinguishes effect and usable confirmation/unknown; sqlite one-writer/busy/isolation claims bound local fixture only. Same key by itself establishes no exactly-once general guarantee.
comparisons.disposition: adapt interaction refinements; rely on mechanism docs only for actual local mechanism

comparisons.source: CTFL1.1/1.3 original PDF15/18; GOV S12 lines133–241
comparisons.selectedLine: Need/recipient-grounded task criterion and appropriate observation with help separated.
comparisons.rival: All specified features pass, therefore need met.
comparisons.sameEffortContrast: With same min(3,1)=1 result, explicit full-kit criterion rejects what min-spec accepts at trivial additional checking effort. A human-understanding claim adds participant cost only when that claim matters; syntax/scenario work remains useful with stated limits.
comparisons.sourceJudgement: CTFL explicitly orthogonalizes V&V and static/dynamic; GOV requires actual/likely users, meaningful neutral tasks and observation; permitted help is separate, not a fake unaided success. No human test claimed.
comparisons.disposition: adopt distinction, adapt GOV task/participant/help conditions

comparisons.selectedLine: Per-assertion actual bases plus known change reach and targeted recheck.
comparisons.rival: Rerun all; rerun changed file only.
comparisons.sameEffortContrast: Full rerun is acceptable for a small cheap suite; when wider expensive, known dependency reach preserves adequate results. Changed-file-only loses currency unit consumers even for small diff. Tradeoff is explicit, not a claimed measured saving.
comparisons.sourceJudgement: SYSE13 separates configuration/description/actual installation; SYSE19 follows claim reliance before excluding reach; RMP8 retains supported scope and uncertainty rather than promoting unseen result. SVV follows these contributions.
comparisons.disposition: adapt named suppliers for software checking

limits: Saved capture currentness only, no live external state verification or performance evidence inferred.
